messages:
Jordan: quick flag — our p99 for /v1/generate on eu-west is ~450ms higher than us-west even after route-weighting adjustments :thinking:
Maria: hmm, do you mean the dashboard p99 or the endpoint rollup p99?
Jordan: dashboard widget for endpoint breakdown (per-route rollup). p50/p95 look fine, just p99 is weird. we switched to tdigest merge last week so thought maybe that's it
Alex: tdigest merging can overshoot if sample counts are small or buckets get merged across heterogeneous latencies. do we have raw sample counts per-route?
Jordan: stats-bot posted snapshots earlier, but here's the quick query I ran in console:

```
SELECT route, count, pct_50, pct_95, pct_99 FROM latency_rollups
WHERE env='prod' AND endpoint='/v1/generate' AND window='5m' ORDER BY route
```

Jordan: results: route A count=18 p99=120ms, route B count=7 p99=580ms, route C count=240 p99=140ms
Samir: route B has very low sample count and high variance — tdigest approximation with small N is unstable. we should surface sample_count alongside percentiles in the widget :eyes:
Maria: agreed. UX asks for a tooltip already but it's not visible by default. low counts should show a warning and maybe show raw samples when N<30
Alex: alternative is to compute p99 from raw samples for low-N cohorts and fallback to tdigest for large-N. add a flag in rollup merge: `prefer_raw_if_count_lt=30`
Jordan: that sounds reasonable. also curious about routing policy effects — if a small percentage of traffic is routed to a GPU-heavy bucket with different latency distribution, merged tdigest across routes could hide that. we should not merge routes that have different routing tags unless asked
Samir: we have route tags but rollup currently merges across all routes by endpoint. we can change merge keys to include `route_tag` for the dashboard endpoint breakdowns
Maria: will this explode cardinality? yes, but for the endpoint breakdown view it's expected. for the global endpoint p99 metric we can keep coarse merge
Alex: quick patch idea: dashboard query adds `HAVING sum(count) > 0` and returns both merged tdigest p99 and a fallback p99_raw when available. small code example:

```
// pseudo
if (sum_count < 30) return compute_raw_percentile(samples, 0.99)
else return tdigest_percentile(merged_tdigest, 0.99)
```

Maria: +1. also add tooltip: "p99 computed from N samples (N shown). tdigest used when N>=30."
Jordan: action items: (1) Samir — change rollup merge key for endpoint-breakdown widget to include route_tag (non-global) (2) Alex — add fallback raw-percentile path for N<30 in query layer (3) Maria — update dashboard tooltip and add small warning UI for low N
Samir: noted, I'll open a PR for the rollup key change and mark it experimental for the widget only
Alex: I'll prototype the compute_raw_percentile function and wire it into query API, should be a small change (psuedo O(n) local compute for tiny N)
Maria: I'll update the dashboard copy and add the tooltip + example. we should also surface sample variance or IQR in the widget
Jordan: thanks all. one more: can stats-bot post the tdigest merge config and an example of a merged tdigest vs raw samples for route B? would help write tests
stats-bot: snapshot uploaded: https://internal.redwood/stats/t_digest_snapshots/3369001111 (contains merged tdigest, per-route digests, and raw sample dump) :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Jordan: perfect. let's reconvene after PRs land, leaning towards small-N raw fallback + route-tagged rollups as the fix
Alex: sounds good. I'll add unit tests for percentile parity between raw and tdigest for multiple N buckets
Samir: FYI I'll also add an opt-out flag for teams that want to keep pre-merge behavior for historical continuity
Maria: thanks — I'll schedule a quick postmortem note in the dashboard changelog when deployed
Jordan: closing the loop here, ping me if anyone hits edge cases in staging
